subject: Request: AWS co-sell intro with Finovate — solution mapping & joint account plan
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@amazon.com>, Elliot Grant <elliot.grant@finovate.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Request: AWS co-sell intro with Finovate — solution mapping & joint account plan

Hi Samantha and Elliot,

Quick intro — I’m Vivek, Partnerships at Redwood Inference. We help teams run high-throughput LLM inference with predictable latency and cost across hosted and private deployments. We’ve been working with mid-market fintechs on latency-sensitive use cases (real-time scoring, in-product assistants), and Finovate sounds like a great candidate for a co-sell collaboration with AWS.

Samantha — would you be open to making a warm intro to the AWS field account team for Finovate and helping us scope a joint account plan? Goal is to:
- Map Finovate’s top three use cases (fraud scoring, customer support assistant, document ingestion) to potential AWS incentives and workloads.
- Align on an initial pilot scope, success metrics, and procurement timeline.
- Identify the AWS contacts (field/tech/TAM) who should join a joint kickoff.

I’ve attached a short one-pager (redwood_awscosell_onepager.pdf) and a draft opportunity worksheet to speed the planning. Proposed times for a 45-min kickoff next week: Tue 14th 10–11am PT, Wed 15th 1–2pm PT, or Thu 16th 9–10am PT. Happy to adapt.

Elliot — looping you in for confirmation if Finovate would be interested in an AWS co-sell route and any compliance or procurement constraints upfront.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood_awscosell_onepager.pdf (summary, 1 page)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@amazon.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Elliot Grant <elliot.grant@finovate.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: AWS co-sell intro with Finovate — solution mapping & joint account plan

Thanks Vivek — happy to help.

I can introduce you to the Finovate account team and loop in the local TAM. Priya (copied) is our partner solutions lead — she’ll help map incentives. Can you share a brief (1-page) pilot success criteria and any target dates for procurement?

I’m available for a 45-min kickoff Wed 15th 11–11:45am PT or Thu 16th 9–9:45am PT. If those don’t work, propose times and I’ll coordinate with the account team.

Thanks Vivek — this looks promising. We are actively evaluating models for our in-product assistant pilot and would like to understand performance and cost trade-offs.

A couple of notes from our side:
- Security/compliance folks will want to see SOC-2 evidence and data residency options — I can add our InfoSec manager to the kickoff if useful.
- Procurement timeline: we’re aiming to decide on a pilot vendor by end of Q1 2027; pilot to start in April.

Wed 15th 11–11:45am PT works for me. Please include a short agenda and any pre-reads so our technical lead can review.
